title: Cabin Fever
start: Talk to Bill Teach in the Port Phasmatys Inn, The Green Ghost.

recommended.t: If you have not completed Ghosts Ahoy, ecto-tokens and a ghostspeak amulet or some coins to charter a ship are needed.
If you have completed Ghosts Ahoy, an ectophial helps you to get to the Port Phasmatys faster.

kills.t: None, but beware of level 26 pirates.

rewards.t: 10,000 coins (only if you speak to Bill Teach after the quest)
Access to kill cave horrors and unspeakable horrors
The ability to understand pirates on Mos Le'Harmless with the Little Book o' Piracy

steps.t: Travel to Port Phasmatys.
Talk to Bill Teach in the inn. [Chat: 1 Yes, I've always wanted to be a pirate! › Accept]
Run to the dock and cross the gangplank to board the eastern-most ship.
Talk to Bill Teach. [Chat: 1 Let's go Cap'n!]
Search the repair locker, take 4 ropes.
Search the Gun Locker, take 1 fuse.
Climb-up the ship's ladder.
Climb the climbing net next to the central mast.
Use rope from the backpack on the hoisted sail on the ship you are on.

sub.t: The same actions of climbing and using the rope are used to change ships every time.

steps.t: Add fuse on the powder barrel on the eastern ship.
Light the fuse (you may fail and have to retry).
Climb the climbing net and use the rope on the hoisted sail as before.
Talk to Bill.
Climb-down the ship's ladder.
Search the repair locker and take:
For each of the three leaks in the hull:
Climb-up the ship's ladder and talk to Bill.

sub.t: Be sure to finish all the dialogue, or else you won't be able to proceed.

steps.t: Board the other ship (climb and use rope as before).
Climb-down their Ship's ladder.
Plunder the closed chest for 5 plunder.
Return to your ship (climb and use rope as before).
Climb-down your ship's ladder.
Store-plunder on the plunder storage.
Return to and talk to Bill.
Climb-down the ship's ladder.
Search the gun locker for a cannon barrel.
Repair the broken cannon on the top deck.
Talk to Bill.
Search the gun locker and take:

sub.t: Some fuses (take 3 in case of failure).
Some cannon canisters (take 3 in case of failure).

steps.t: Climb-up the ship's ladder.
Prepare and fire the cannon. If you miss you will need to repeat these steps.

sub.t: If you make a mistake, you can empty-out the cannon. You will still need to clean it with the ramrod (final instruction).
Take-powder from the powder barrel next to the cannon on the deck.
Fire! the cannon. Check your chat log to see if you hit or not.
Use the ramrod on the cannon again to clean it.

p: Firing the cannon at the enemy pirates

steps.t: Talk to Bill.
Return to the gun locker and take:

sub.t: 2 cannon barrel (the cannon may blow up).

steps.t: Fire the cannon as before, substituting the canister for a cannon ball, until you put three holes in the enemy's ship.
Quest complete!
Talk to Bill to claim another reward.
